subject: POC network activation — MAP milestones & peering window
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@proofpoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: POC network activation — MAP milestones & peering window

Hi Liam / ProofPoint infra team,

Thanks for the productive call this morning. Per our MAP, I'm attaching a working copy of the mutual action plan and the CIDR list we asked for so we can lock the networking tasks into the sprint. Key ask items we need to confirm to move the POC from eval -> staging: 

- Org setup: we need a sandbox org created and an admin service account (email or service principal) to link to our activation process.
- API keys: one ephemeral API key for smoke tests, one long-lived service key for load tests.
- IP allowlist: please confirm the /24 ranges you want to allow; we've attached a template file to fill in.
- VPC peering: proposed 2-hour maintenance window for peering exchange (prefer Tue/Wed after 18:00 PT).

Can you confirm CIDRs and whether you prefer a single peering connection or per-environment peering (staging/prod)? We'll plan a canary peering first and then scale.

Attachments: MAP-Proofpoint-v1.xlsx (MAP with milestones), pp-network-cidrs.txt (fill-your-cidrs).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm CIDR list by EOD Thu 9/16
2) We provide VPC peering config and temporary API key by Mon 9/20
3) Joint peering test + smoke by Tues 9/21 (2h window)

If any of these dates don't work for you, flag and we'll adjust.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@proofpoint.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: eng-infra <eng@proofpoint.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC network activation — MAP milestones & peering window

Michael — thanks, this is clear.

Quick answers:
- CIDRs: we'll populate pp-network-cidrs.txt with two /24s (10.42.12.0/24 and 10.42.13.0/24) and return by tomorrow EOD.
- Peering approach: we prefer a single peering per-environment (separate for staging/prod) — canary on staging first.
- API keys: can do ephemeral key for you; please send the key request email with the service account identity to eng-infra.

On timing, Tue 9/21 after 18:00 PT works for our infra team but can we make the window 18:00–20:00 PT to give room for rollbacks?

I'll also attach our internal security checklist for your review.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Director, Platform Engineering
ProofPoint Labs

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@proofpoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC network activation — MAP milestones & peering window

Liam — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Noted on the two /24s and single-per-environment peering. I'll update the MAP workbook and lock the 18:00–20:00 PT window for the staging canary on Tue 9/21.

A couple of clarifications from our side before we request the ephemeral key from you: 
- For the ephemeral key: we ask that the key be scoped to the sandbox org and limited to read+generate for 72 hours. We'll rotate it after the smoke run.
- Org admin: please assign one user principal or a service account we can reference (e.g., proofpoint-poc-admin@proofpoint.com).
- Firewall/ports: our runtime needs outbound TCP to 443 and 5222 for healthcheck telemetry; inbound isn't required for the peered subnets.

I'll attach a short activation checklist in the MAP workbook (row: networking tasks) so the CS and infra teams can tick items as complete. Once we have your CIDRs filled in, Karthik will send the specific peering config object we need on your side (route tables, allowed prefixes, ASN if applicable).

Thanks — scheduling note: I'll block a 30m pre-peering sync 30m ahead of the canary to walk through the runbook.

Best,
Michael

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood-inference.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@proofpoint.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC network activation — MAP milestones & peering window

Michael / Liam — quick technical notes from the infra side before we finalize config: 

- Peering details we'll need filled: your VPC ID, routing propagation preference, and whether you use a transitive NAT gateway. If you have a dedicated ASN, include that in the peering object.
- Service account: we recommend a JWT-based service principal for automated rotation rather than static long-lived keys. If ProofPoint can't provide that, we'll accept a long-lived key but request periodic rotation (30 days).
- Ports: confirm that 5222 is okay for telemetry; if compliance restricts that, we can route telemetry over 443 as a fallback (slightly higher latency).
- ACLs: our canary requires your peer to accept 10.42.12.0/24 -> 172.31.8.0/23 (redwood staging). We'll provide the redwood side prefixes in the peering object.

Attached: vpc-peering-guide.pdf (sample config snippets we use). I'll post the exact terraform snippet to the map workbook under the "Peering snippets" tab once we have confirmed CIDRs.

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@proofpoint.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Sep 2027 15:21:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: POC network activation — MAP milestones & peering window

Thanks Karthik — that all looks reasonable.

We've filled the CIDR template and attached proofpoint-scc-list.pdf with the security items we need Redwood to confirm (TLS versions, key rotation policy, logging retention).

Next steps for us:
- I'll open the DocuSign for the MAP SOW and send the link (expect within the hour).
- We confirm the staging peering on Tue 9/21 18:00–20:00 PT — we accept the 30m pre-sync.
- eng-infra will create proofpoint-poc-admin@proofpoint.com as a service identity and DM credentials to Michael's team.

If you can drop the terraform snippet into the MAP workbook when ready, we can start the pre-checks tomorrow.

Appreciate the coordination — looking forward to the canary.

Best,
Liam

Attachments: proofpoint-scc-list.pdf
